title: Jeremiah's Word to Baruch
description: In the fourth year of King Jehoiakim, the prophet Jeremiah spoke a word from the Lord to the scribe Baruch son of Neriah, while he was writing Jeremiah's words in a scroll. Baruch complained: "Woe is me! The Lord adds sorrow to my pain, and I find no rest." The Lord answered that He would tear down what He had built and uproot what He had planted throughout the land. Baruch should not seek great things for himself, for disaster will come upon all flesh – but God promises to preserve his life as spoil wherever he goes. [ref:Jer 45:1-5|Jeremiah 45:1-5]
